content_sections.heading: IGKV Gariaband Guest Faculty Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 40 years. SC, ST, OBC and women candidates get five years of relaxation as per C.G. Govt. Rules. Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture / Veterinary faculty with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 in 10 point scales) with good academic record. Candidates with a Master degree must also have passed NET (National Eligibility Test) and have one publication in a NAAS rated referred journal in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Ph.D. holders may be exempted from NET if the Ph.D. was done with course work as prescribed by UGC Regulation 2009 and the candidate has at least two full length publications with a NAAS rating of not less than 4 on the last date of submission of application. A Ph.D. without course work does not qualify for the NET exemption. If no candidates meet these criteria, the university may consider candidates with a PG degree in the relevant subject. With the competent authority's approval, they would be paid per day and engaged for one academic session only. The official notification gives the discipline-specific eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview at the College of Agriculture, Raipur, IGKV (C.G.). The date and time of the interview will be notified on the university website. Bring all your original documents for verification on the interview day. Candidates who do not bring them cannot appear in the interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

rows.date: Will be notified on University website

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The Guest Faculty post is purely temporary. Selected candidates cannot claim a regular appointment on any post advertised by Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya, Raipur, on the basis of this experience. The appointment lasts one year, or until a regular faculty member is posted in the subject, whichever is earlier. Guest Faculty perform duties in research, teaching, examination, laboratory, sports, cultural activities and other assignments given from time to time. If a selected candidate's performance is found unsatisfactory, the services can be withdrawn with one week's notice. A candidate whose credentials are found to be wrong will be removed from the rolls. Selected candidates must submit an affidavit on judicial stamp paper of Rs. 50/- to the Dean, College of Agriculture and Research Station, Gariaband (C.G.)-493992. The affidavit records agreement with the terms and conditions, in the format prescribed by IGKV.

faq.question: Q1. Which disciplines have Guest Faculty posts at IGKV Gariaband?
faq.answer: Plant Pathology, Livestock Production & Management, Agricultural Economics, and Genetics and Plant Breeding each have one post.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the College of Agriculture, Raipur, IGKV (C.G.), not at Gariaband. The date and time will be announced on the university website.

faq.question: Q3. Is NET compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, for Master's degree holders. They also need one publication in a NAAS rated referred journal. Ph.D. holders with UGC Regulation 2009 course work and at least two full length publications rated NAAS 4 or above are exempted from NET.

faq.question: Q4. How much will a Guest Faculty with a Ph.D. earn?
faq.answer: Rs.1800/- per day, up to Rs.40,000/- per month, whether or not the candidate has also passed NET.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum percentage required in the Master's degree?
faq.answer: At least 55% marks, or an equivalent grade of 6.50 on a 10 point scale.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: One year, or until regular faculty are posted in the subject, whichever comes first. The post is temporary and gives no claim to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Do I send the application by post?
faq.answer: No. Send the filled form and all documents as a single PDF file by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to candidates who appear in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What must selected candidates submit after selection?
faq.answer: An affidavit on Rs. 50/- judicial stamp paper, in IGKV's prescribed format, agreeing to the terms and conditions. It goes to the Dean, College of Agriculture and Research Station, Gariaband (C.G.)-493992.
